title: Unique Croatian Egg White Frittata
description: A weeknight Croatian dish featuring egg white, temper, and floral flavors, served on a wooden board, this Unique Croatian Egg White Frittata is a shojin-friendly meal option that combines crunchy textures with delicate flavors, perfect for a quick dinner

ingredients.name: temper
ingredients.notes: or substitute with apple cider vinegar

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the egg whites, temper, dried lavender buds, salt, and black pepper until stiff peaks form.
Heat the olive oil in a 10 inch oven safe skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped almonds to the skillet and cook until lightly toasted, about 2 minutes.
Pour the egg white mixture over the almonds in the skillet.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15 minutes or until the edges are set and the center is slightly jiggly.
Remove the skillet from the oven and sprinkle the chopped parsley over the top of the frittata.
Let the frittata cool in the skillet for 5 minutes before slicing and serving on a wooden board.
